empty: No doctrine entities yet. Modern HOI4 doctrines live in common/doctrines/. Create a folder, grand doctrine, track, or subdoctrine.
selectHint: Select a doctrine entity or create a new one.
iconLibraryTitle: Choose or upload a project icon
iconLibraryHint: Choose an uploaded project icon, or upload an image under a valid GFX name. Type a vanilla/base-mod GFX reference directly in the field.
iconDialogDescription: Browse project icons. Double-click to choose one, or upload a new icon below. Vanilla and base-mod doctrine references remain available through manual GFX entry.
iconDialogUploadDescription: Upload an image under a doctrine-safe GFX sprite name. Letters, digits, and underscores are accepted; the selected name is written back to this doctrine.
masteryHint: Raw mastery block: multiplier + the equipment / sub_units / categories that generate mastery. Tokens not translated.
tracksHint: Space-separated track entity_keys this grand doctrine contains. Not translated.
milestonesHint: One entry per milestone — name + its raw effects body. Round-trips verbatim.
xorHint: 1.19: subdoctrine names that are mutually exclusive with this one — no braces here. Separate them with spaces or new lines; saving normalizes them to one space-separated list, and the export re-wraps it in the xor block. Leave empty to omit the key.
allowMultipleTracksHint: 1.19: emits 'allow_in_multiple_tracks = yes' — this subdoctrine may appear in more than one track. Unchecked by default = unset (key not written).
rewardsHint: One entry per reward — name + its raw body (the deepest doctrine block). Round-trips verbatim.
noMilestones: No milestones yet. Click "+ Add milestone".
noRewards: No rewards yet. Click "+ Add reward".
rawExtrasHint: modifiers · ai_will_do · available · every other preserved key — round-trips verbatim (mastery / tracks / milestones / rewards have structured editors above)
rawExtrasNote: JSON object. Block values (e.g. milestones, rewards, ai_will_do) are stored as HOI4 script text — export re-wraps them in
rawExtrasMustBeObject: raw_extras must be a JSON object
emptyHeroDesc: Modern HOI4 doctrines live in common/doctrines/. Start with a folder, grand doctrine, track, or subdoctrine.
